about.title: Flavorful Encounters at The Golden Olive
about.description: Don't feel like cooking today? Come by and enjoy delicious dishes with family and friends. At The Golden Olive, we treat you to breathtaking soul food, prepared with the best ingredients and a passion for flavor. Check out our menu online. Reservations are not required, so feel free to drop in and experience the warm hospitality of our bistro-restaurant.

takeaway.title: Takeaway
takeaway.description: Call us, tell us your favorite dishes and when you want to pick them up. We'll make sure your food is ready.

delivery.title: Order and Enjoy at Home
delivery.description: Place your order via our website or by phone, and we'll bring your favorite dishes directly to your door.

reservation.title: Reservation
reservation.description: Reservations are not necessary, as we work with a 'first come, first serve' policy.

birthdays.title: Birthdays
birthdays.description:
Celebrate your birthday in style with a unique party at our restaurant.
Enjoy delicious food, a festive atmosphere and excellent service.
We ensure an unforgettable birthday.

corporate.title: Corporate Events
corporate.description: Organize a professional and successful corporate event at our restaurant. Whether it's a team building, company anniversary or end-of-year party, we offer the perfect setting and catering for your event.

other.title: Other Events
other.description: From family celebrations and anniversaries to special gatherings and more, our restaurant offers a warm and inviting environment for all kinds of events. We're happy to help you plan and execute your special occasion.

cookieConsent.title: Cookie Consent
cookieConsent.description: We use cookies and local storage to enhance your browsing experience, save your language preference, and analyze our traffic. By clicking 'Accept', you consent to our use of cookies.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.text1: This Cookie Policy explains how The Golden Olive (hereinafter "we", "us", "restaurant") uses cookies and similar technologies on our website.
introduction.text2: By using our website, you consent to the use of cookies in accordance with this policy.

whatAreCookies.title: 2. What are cookies?
whatAreCookies.text1: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device (computer, tablet or mobile device) when you visit a website.
whatAreCookies.text2: Cookies allow websites to remember information, such as your language preference, and help improve your browsing experience.

essential.title: 3.1 Essential cookies
essential.text: These cookies are essential for the functioning of our website. They allow you to navigate the site and use its features. Without these cookies, certain services cannot be offered.

functional.title: 3.2 Functional cookies
functional.text: These cookies remember your preferences (such as your language preference) and provide an improved, more personalized experience.

analytics.title: 3.3 Analytics cookies
analytics.text: These cookies help us understand how visitors use our website by collecting information about the number of visitors, pages visited and time spent on the site.

howWeUseCookies.title: 4. How do we use cookies?
howWeUseCookies.use3: To collect website analytics and statistics

managingCookies.title: 5. Managing cookies
managingCookies.text1: You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to refuse or delete cookies.
managingCookies.text2: Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of our website.
managingCookies.note: Note: By disabling cookies, some features of our website may not work correctly.

thirdPartyCookies.title: 6. Third-party cookies
thirdPartyCookies.text: Our website may use third-party cookies, such as Google Maps for location display. These services have their own cookie policies that you should consult.

contact.title: 7. Contact
contact.text: For questions about our use of cookies, you can contact us:
